title: WanderingTraderSellingChests
description: a simple mod that lets wandering traders sell chests filled with loot from various structure loot tables.
body:
### This is a simple mod that lets wandering traders sell chests filled with loot from various structure loot tables

_As we all know, wandering traders roam across the entire world—so why do they only peddle overpriced junk?  
This mod aims to fix that odd situation, cut down on the time players spend hunting for structures, and make certain items reasonably renewable._

- **Configurable options**:
1. Which loot tables can be used
2. Maximum number of trades per wandering trader
3. Cost of each trade
4. Probability of a trade appearing
5. Position of the trade item in the trading list

- **ItemBlacklist**: Prevents specific items from appearing in the chests, so players can’t obtain overpowered gear too early.

- **Q&A**: No questions received yet.
